headline: HyProMag Plans Three New Plants to Quadruple U.S. Magnet Capacity
summary: HyProMag USA has mapped out plans for three new magnet manufacturing plants aimed at quadrupling its United States production capacity.
why: HyProMag operates in the critical rare-earth magnet supply chain, which is vital for electric vehicles, electronics, and defense applications.

impacts.name: Critical Minerals Manufacturing
impacts.why: Expanding domestic magnet production capacity reduces reliance on foreign supply chains for critical industrial components.
